'''Fetid zombies''' are [[monster]]s that swarm the northern gates of [[Fort Forinthry]] during the [[Unwelcome Guests]] quest. Throughout the quest, the player will need to defeat a total of 20 of them. Although there are two variants that are visually distinct, both possess identical combat stats.
